text:
This week’s code grew a few extra rooms. Sandboxes can keep files and processes through daily restarts, with creation and lifecycle controls together in Enter. Image, video, audio and 3D requests gained async jobs; the SDK picked up more generation tools and React hooks. New models joined the catalog, agents got clearer docs and MCP tools, and keys can grant access more precisely. Also: simpler sign-in, more accessible controls and optional image metadata stripping. A lot of small doors opened. Browse the work at github.com/pollinations and pollinations.ai.
